items.title: Want $4,500 in Passive Income? Invest $100,000 Into This Insurance Giant’s 18-Year Dividend Growth Streak
items.summary: A $100,000 stake in one insurance giant has been quietly raising its dividend for 18 straight years, but a Treasury bond paying 5.35% is sitting right there as a rival. Choosing between them depends on risks most income investors never think to price.
